subject: Demo recap & proposed pilot evaluation plan — LatticeCore
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@latticecore.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticecore.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-03-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Demo recap & proposed pilot evaluation plan — LatticeCore

Hi Jordan / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday — appreciated the practical questions on inference cost and data controls. Below is a concise recap of what we covered and a proposed 6-week pilot (POC) that will let LatticeCore validate performance, integration effort, and unit economics with a narrow, measurable scope.

What we demoed (recap)
- Redwood API: streaming generation, function/tool calls, structured output support.
- Dedicated vs Hosted routing: options we discussed for predictable throughput and data isolation.
- Observability: per-route latency/cost breakdowns, token-level traces, and rollback/rollout tooling.
- Optimize: batching and cache recommendations we suggested for your use case (short conversational prompts + 3rd-party context enrichments).

Proposed pilot objective
- Goal: Assess production viability for LatticeCore’s Summarize+QA workflow at 1k concurrent sessions and validate cost/latency targets while verifying data controls.

Success criteria (pass/fail checkpoints)
1) Latency: 95th percentile generation latency <= 450 ms for 512-token median requests under the pilot traffic profile.
2) Cost: Token cost reduction consistent with Redwood Optimize recommendations — target <= $0.0035 per 1k tokens for steady-state workload.
3) Quality: Summarization ROUGE-L >= 0.56 and human acceptance >= 85% on a 50-example blind eval set.
4) Reliability: No more than 1 incident requiring failover during the 2-week steady-state window.
5) Data controls: End-to-end encryption at rest, per-request audit logs, and confirmable retention policy for test data (30 days).

Pilot plan (6 weeks) — high level
- Week 0 (prep): NDA/SOW signature, sample dataset delivery (anonymized 2000 session transcripts), Redwood test account + API keys.
- Weeks 1–2 (integration): Ingest connectors, baseline generation runs, telemetry hooks. Owner: LatticeCore (Jordan) + Redwood onboarding (Marissa).
- Weeks 3–4 (load & tuning): Run scaled traffic, enable KV caching and batching suggestions, iterate on prompts and quantization profile. Owner: Naomi (infra) + Jordan.
- Week 5 (blind eval): Collect 100 blind samples for ROUGE/human eval, run cost analysis.
- Week 6 (wrap & next steps): Review results, recommend production path (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private).

Owners & contacts
- LatticeCore: Jordan Ellis (product lead) — overall pilot owner and dataset provider.
- Redwood: Marissa Cole — onboarding and success plan; Naomi Feldman — infra/quantization + deployment runbook.
- Contract / procurement: Priya Shah (LatticeCore) — legal/pricing touchpoint.

Immediate asks from your side
1) Confirm the 2000 anonymized transcripts can be shared by EOD Friday (we will provide a secure upload link).
2) Confirm the key success criteria above or suggest one change — we can adjust the ROUGE threshold or latency target if you prefer.
3) Sign the SOW so we can provision dedicated capacity and schedule the Week 1 onboarding slot.

Attachments: I’ve attached a one-page POC checklist, a draft SOW, and a small architecture diagram.

If this looks good I’ll propose Friday, Mar 24 at 10am PT for a 30–45 minute kickoff (technical + product).

Thanks —
Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0192

Attachment stubs:
- POC-Checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- SOW-draft-LatticeCore.pdf (PDF, 5 pages)
- Redwood-Architecture-Diagram.png (PNG)

From: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@latticecore.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticecore.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-03-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed pilot evaluation plan — LatticeCore

Karthik —

Thanks for the clear recap and plan. We’re aligned on the overall approach and OK with the 6-week window. A couple quick notes/questions:
- Can we relax the ROUGE-L target to 0.52 for the blind eval — we care more about human acceptance for extractive highlights.
- We need clarity on data retention: can Redwood confirm logs/audit artifacts will be retained for 90 days for our audit team (we can agree to a separate retention window for raw transcript storage).
- Our legal team wants SOC 2 evidence before signing the SOW. Can you share the SOC 2 report URL or a secure download?

Also looping Priya (procurement) — Priya, do you have the budget approval timeline?

Happy to proceed with the kickoff on Mar 24 if we can get the SOC2 and a short confirmation on retention.

—Jordan
Jordan Ellis
Head of Product, LatticeCore
jordan.ellis@latticecore.ai
+1 (650) 555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Cc: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@latticecore.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticecore.ai>
Date: 2028-03-21T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed pilot evaluation plan — LatticeCore

Karthik / Naomi —

Quick internal alignment notes before we respond to Jordan:
- Accept the ROUGE tweak to 0.52 (makes sense given their focus on extractive highlights). We should keep human-acceptance >= 85% as stated.
- SOC 2: Naomi, can you prepare a secure link to our SOC 2 Type II artifact and a brief note on the scope (hosted control plane + data handling) — Jordan’s legal will want that first.
- Retention: we can offer 90-day audit log retention and 30-day raw transcript retention by default; if they need 90 for raw transcripts we should flag as an approved exception and capture in the SOW.
- Capacity: Naomi — confirm if we need to provision Dedicated capacity upfront for the pilot or if Hosted reserved CPU/GPU burst is sufficient for their 1k concurrent target. If Dedicated is required, we’ll need procurement signoff.

Naomi — I can handle onboarding and weekly checkpoints; can you prepare a short infra runbook (2–3 bullets) and a quantization profile recommendation we tested?

Karthik — once you update the POC checklist with the ROUGE change and retention options, I’ll reply to Jordan + Priya and propose the kickoff slot.

Thanks,
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Customer Success, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.inference>
To: Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@latticecore.ai>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@latticecore.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.inference>
Date: 2028-03-22T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Demo recap & proposed pilot evaluation plan — LatticeCore

Jordan / Priya —

Thanks for the quick reply and the ROUGE adjustment — noted and accepted. A few concrete items we’ve actioned:

1) SOC 2: Naomi has uploaded the SOC 2 Type II report to a secure link — https://secure.redwood.inference/soc2/2027-type2 (access granted to your legal team; password will be sent by separate email).
2) Retention options: By default we’ll configure 90-day audit log retention and 30-day raw transcript retention. If you need raw transcript retention to be 90 days, we’ll add that as an exception in the SOW and mark it as a procurement item for Priya.
3) Capacity: Naomi recommends Hosted with burst reservations for pilot traffic. If we see noisy high concurrency during Weeks 3–4 we’ll convert to a short Dedicated reservation — we’ve flagged this as an option in the POC checklist.
4) Updated artifacts: attached an updated POC-Checklist.xlsx that reflects the ROUGE-L change and retention options, and the SOW-draft link (DocuSign) for signature: https://app.docusign.com/some-doc-link/abcd1234

Next steps (short)
- Priya: let us know procurement timeline. If you can sign SOW by Mar 23 EOD we’ll confirm the Mar 24 kickoff.
- Jordan: please upload the anonymized 2k transcripts to the secure upload link I’ll send in a follow-up email.
- Marissa: propose a 45-minute technical onboarding agenda for Mar 24 (I’ll leave timing to you).

Thanks everyone — looking forward to getting started.

Best,
Karthik
--
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
